title: Motion Studio M2: independent render receipt verifier and drift detection
desc: Follow-up infrastructure only after M1 PR #57. Recompute every accepted frame PNG hash and structural metrics; check frame order/count/time, optional critic threshold truthfulness, video hash/decode counts and bounded attempts. Add source-module/engine fingerprints and explicit intentional-hold evidence. Reject tampering/incomplete runs. Separate CLI + adversarial tests; does NOT implement artistic critic/springs/beat analysis. Stack on M1 until it merges.
